title: Wonderful tour, by Julio!
text: Julio was a wonderful guide! He took us in his car since it was just 2 of us. The views were amazing and his knowledge of the area was fantastic. Highly recommend!
author: SUSAN_J

title: We had a wonderful time...
text: We had a wonderful time going up into the Sierra Nevada mountains with Julio. The scenery was spectacular, he was a very pleasant guide and a careful driver on the winding mountain roads.
author: Rena_H

title: Impressive views
text:
We felt we were being driven very safely on the twisting mountain roads, which was an important consideration! 
We had incredibly impressive views, and took two or three easy strolls. We saw a booted eagle, a mountain goat, a lizard and many wild flowers. We were sent some very good photos afterwards.
author: John_C

title: Loved Every Second! An amazing experience
text: My mom and I had so much fun!!! Julio was just amazing. He was a great driver, accommodating, and had snacks and water for us. He was extremely knowledgeable and knew the best places to go. Could not recommend this more. I would consider this a light hike - you drive for a bit, stop, walk around, sightsee, and continue on. But, there’s also lots of room for adventure! It was a perfect mix.
author: Olivia_T

title: Excellent tour
text: Excellent 4 hour trip. Julios was very informative, it was just enough to see the amazing views of the Nevada. Great for anyone with mobility issues as very little walking.
author: TraceyParsons1234

title: Fabulous, well organised and stunning scenery.
text: I think just ensure warm clothes as will be outside high in the mountains.  It is very beautiful so totally worth it.
author: Jane_P

title: Great experience.
text: Lovely trip to the top of Sierra Nevada. And much easier than hiking it! We would definitely book it again. Lots of great pictures and we managed to see some mountain goats too.
author: scottwX4103AA

title: Vistas with an excellent host.
text:
Great break from the city. Julio was an excellent host and very informative. We had the van to ourselves due to most tourists returning home to get kids to school. Julio's willingness to take only two people for the entire trip speaks well for his dedication and character.
Well done. Highly recommend for the natural beauty and grandeur of the original Sierra Madre.
author: jay s

title: Beautiful Sierra Nevada
text: We as a family with young children enjoyed this tour very much. We got to see the Sierra Nevada at different stops with beautifull views and a little walk.
author: Nina V

title: An Incredible Excursion out of the City
text: This was our favorite activity in Spain. Everyone tells you to visit the Alhambra when you go to Granada, but you’re really missing out if you skip the Sierras. Julio was a great guide, knowledgeable, easygoing, and clearly loves the area. He took us to some beautiful spots, and we were lucky enough to see snow on the peak and mountain goats along the way. Afterward, we wished we’d booked his other tour to Monachil too. It was such a great way to get out of the city and see the incredible natural landscape around Granada.
author: Travel448983
